title: create_text failed with timeout
body: Received message from client: {"id":"xxx","error":"in set_characters: Cannot write to node with unloaded font \"Inter Regular\". Please call figma.loadFontAsync({ family: \"Inter\", style: \"Regular\" }) and await the returned promise first."}
author: cometbaydo

comments.body: Same here! Edit, fixed by removing the getFontStyle() function and replacing with "Regular" string
Just published the fix, you can try again
